d: US President Donald Trump has confirmed that the FBI is investigating allegations surrounding Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s relationship with a Chinese woman suspected of having links to Chinese intelligence. Huang has admitted to being unfaithful to his wife and apologised to his family and Nvidia employees. Meanwhile, Nvidia’s board has launched an independent investigation, and the company’s shares have fallen. Was Huang deliberately targeted? Did any sensitive information reach China? Here’s why the allegations have raised questions about technology and US national security.
